title: Potion of Animal Speaking

sources.title: Potions
markers: Other potions simply have no effect

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to understand and speak with beasts until the next Long Rest.

fields.Activation: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle to gain Speak with Animals until the next Long Rest.
fields.Throw: Throwing the potion does not apply the effect.
fields.Crafting: Extract three Acorn Truffles into Essence of Acorn Truffle and add any Salt.
fields.Creative use: Drink before talking to animals that may have witnessed an event.
fields.Base value: 13 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Acquisition: Sources include Arron, Derryth Bonecloak, Sister Lidwin, Volo and the ground near the Selûnite chest in the Owlbear Nest. Digital Deluxe includes one at camp.

changes: Added source-reviewed native BG3 gameplay, consumption, and crafting details.
